name: gpo-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): plants domain-level persistence via Group Policy -- a GPO that writes an HKLM Run-key value onto every machine it applies to. Unlike runkey-persistence-win (a one-box local Run key), this survives on any domain-joined host and only vanishes when the GPO or its registry value is removed. Vars: GPO_NAME (required, created if missing); RUN_VALUE_NAME (required, the Run value the GPO deploys); PAYLOAD_PATH (optional, default C:\ProgramData\Subsystems\gpotelemetry.ps1); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional, default an idle sleep loop -- written to PAYLOAD_PATH locally so the payload has something to run). Must run on a DC. Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-GPO -Name / Get-GPRegistryValue for the planted GPO name and Run value.
